text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn (TTN).

Based on the onset of respiratory distress shortly after birth, the presence of hyperinflation and mediastinal shift on the Chest X-ray, and the absence of meconium aspiration or significant fetal distress indicators, this clinical picture is most consistent with retained fetal lung fluid.

The Arterial Blood Gas results will help confirm the degree of respiratory acidosis, but the radiographic findings are already diagnostic. Please monitor oxygen saturation closely while we prepare for supportive care.
